annotations.title: Search public tenders and contract awards

description: Public procurement notices from official portals in one schema: US SAM.gov (federal), EU TED (every EU/EEA country), UK Find a Tender and Contracts Finder, France BOAMP, Spain PLACSP, Germany, Netherlands TenderNed, Canada CanadaBuys, Colombia SECOP II, Brazil PNCP, India GeM, Ukraine Prozorro, EU institutions (Funding & Tenders portal), US contract awards (USAspending), Australia AusTender (awards) and South Africa eTenders. Title, buyer, deadline, value and currency, CPV/UNSPSC/NAICS codes, sectors, buyer contacts, suppliers for awards, notice link. Open tenders by default. Runs the Apify Actor tacps126/tenders-radar on your Apify account (about $0.004 per notice; spend per call is capped at $0.5).

codes.description: CPV, UNSPSC, NAICS or PSC code prefixes, e.g. ["72"] for IT services (CPV) or ["5415"] (US NAICS).

countries.description: ISO codes, e.g. ["US", "GB", "FR", "CA"], or "EU" for every EU/EEA country.

extra_input.description: Advanced: extra Actor input fields, merged over the defaults.

keywords.description: Words matched literally on title and description; add translations for non-English portals, e.g. ["software", "logiciel"].

max_items.description: Maximum results to return (default 30, max 500). Cost scales with this.

min_value.description: Minimum estimated value in the notice currency.

notice_types.description: tender = open opportunities; award = who won and for how much.

posted_within_days.description: Only notices from the last N days.

sectors.description: Sectors from CPV/UNSPSC/NAICS/PSC codes and multilingual terms (housing = construction and real estate).

states.description: States or regions by name or ISO 3166-2 code, e.g. ["Texas", "IN-MH"]; where the work is or the buyer sits.

name: search_tenders

count.description: Number of records the Actor returned.

items.description: The records. Long text fields are shortened to 600 characters.

shown.description: Number of records included in `items` (can be lower than count when the result is long).

tool.description: Name of the tool that produced the result.

truncated.description: True when records were left out to keep the result short; ask for fewer items.

title: Search public tenders and contract awards
